description_en: Call DeleteSnapshot to delete one or more DBFS snapshots
description_zh: 调用DeleteSnapshot删除一个或多个数据库文件系统的快照
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs delete-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --snapshot-id 's-Q2greuDZTvWeS8bfKZ0000_或者_s-Q2greuDZTvWeS8bfKZ0000_,_s-r4qlmevirw2vwmwv700000' --biz-force false --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the snapshot or a list of snapshot IDs.

- To delete a single snapshot, enter the snapshot ID.

- For batch deletion, enter the snapshot IDs as a JSON array. Separate the IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 snapshot IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh:
快照ID或者快照ID列表。
- 删除单个快照时输入快照ID
- 批量删除时以JSON数组形式输入快照ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，一次最多指定100个快照ID
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force delete the snapshot.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除快照。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force
